scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a USDA housing loan to purchase a home. Could you please let me know the current status of my application? Was it approved, denied, or is it still pending?
dialogue.agent: Thank you for your question. Your USDA housing loan application for a home purchase was completed and the loan was originated. After that, your loan was purchased by Ginnie Mae. There is no denial or pending status; your application resulted in a completed loan that has been sold.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the update! I’m glad to hear my loan was approved and originated. Could you tell me what interest rate I received and what my total loan costs are?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has an interest rate of 6.874%. The total loan costs are $5,908.00.

dialogue.user: Thank you for providing those details. Can you confirm the loan term for me, and let me know if there are any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan term is 360 months. Your loan is not classified as a high-cost (HOEPA) mortgage, and it does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear—thank you for confirming those details. One last question: could you tell me what my debt-to-income ratio means for my application, and whether it impacted my loan terms in any way?
dialogue.agent: The debt-to-income (DTI) ratio represents the percentage of your monthly income that goes toward paying debts. It is typically used to help lenders assess your ability to repay a loan. In your specific loan record, the DTI ratio is not present. The record does not include information about whether your DTI impacted your loan terms.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for explaining. That answers all of my questions.

<Satisfied> — I appreciate the clear responses about my loan status and details. All of my questions were answered promptly and in a way I could understand, and the agent was courteous throughout. I would have preferred a bit more detail on how my personal financial factors affected my loan, but I understand that information isn’t available in the loan record.
